QUOTE: `_bindings.py` is auto-generated by `scripts/gen_bindings.py` from `entropic.h`. Pre-commit runs `gen-bindings --check`, so the committed file can't drift from the header.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says pre-commit runs `gen-bindings --check` so the bindings can't drift from the header. That is the pre-commit generator check the item describes. It doesn't say the check "diffs", but `--check` on a generator implies that.
